items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Wendell McNeil, John McNeil, they came along ahead of Manuel's time.

ctx.x: It was never, of course he made it all hit at the Cockney Club in 1932. That's right.

Now those things should be contradicted and should be roundly contradicted. Should be openly denounced. You want to discredit people who actually put, what are you going to do about James Rodden Johnson and Jay Rosamund Johnson who come along before any of us? Now Jay Rosamund is still alive. If he hasn't died lately. I don't think so. And a more qualified composer and an exponent of the piano you never heard in his boyhood days. His home is Jacksonville, Florida. Wendell McNeil, John McNeil, they came along…
No, no, no, you're not saying anything out of the way. Oh, oh, all right.
